title: A Rigidity Property of the Deformed q-Exponential Function
summary: The deformed \(q\)-exponential function \[ e_q(z,u) = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} u^{\binom{n}{2}} \frac{z^n}{(q;q)_n} \] provides a common framework containing several classical \(q\)-exponential functions as particular cases, including the Jackson \(q\)-exponentials \(e_q(z)\) and \(E_q(z)\). In this paper we investigate the multiplicative inversion problem \[ e_q(z,u)e_q(-z,v)=1, \] and determine all pairs of deformation parameters \((u,v)\) for which this identity holds.
